Package io.webagent4j.action

package io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.

IActionBuilder is the entry point (reached through IPage#action()/IFrame#action() in webagent4j-browser-api), producing an IPreparedAction for one command. execute() runs the backend exactly once and returns an ActionResult; dryRun() validates resolution and preconditions without ever invoking the backend; plan() returns an inspectable, single-use IActionPlan whose execute() reruns the whole pipeline from scratch against live state rather than trusting the snapshot it was built from.

IActionBackend is the extension point a browser backend implements to actually perform each command; every default method throws UnsupportedOperationException unless overridden. This package owns orchestration only - no browser-native implementation - and cannot depend on Playwright or any other concrete backend. See docs/actions.md for every supported command, the retry-safety rules, and the frame-scoped action contract.
